description: Canonical label taxonomy for Project-Mobile-Fortress. Consumed by sync_backlog.py to validate/create labels and by agent_tools.py to route tickets. Component names mirror .agent/AGENTS.md §3 (Module Boundaries). Status and Priority are NOT represented as labels here — this repo's GitHub Project (17) already has native ProjectV2 single-select fields for both (Status: Backlog/Ready/In progress/Rejected/In review/Done; Priority: P0/P1/P2), which agent_tools.py's resolve_status_field()/resolve_priority_field() target directly. Keeping a parallel status:*/priority:* label taxonomy would let the two representations silently drift, so this file only covers what genuinely has no native-field equivalent: component classification and the roadmap:<topic>/agent:* labels already in use.

components.name: component:android
components.description: android/ Kotlin client (SurfaceView game loop, Compose menus/HUD)

components.name: component:ios
components.description: ios/ Swift client (SpriteKit game loop, SwiftUI menus/HUD)

components.name: component:core
components.description: game/ shared assets + documented (not yet compiled) state-machine/level spec; future C++ simulation core

components.name: component:infra
components.description: infra/ optional backend scaffolding (Docker, k8s, Helm, Terraform, Ansible)

components.name: component:docs-website
components.description: docs/website/ React + Vite documentation portal and design hub

components.name: component:ci-automation
components.description: GitHub Actions workflows, git/ hooks and scripts, repo automation

components.name: component:docs
components.description: docs/ content (design docs, roadmaps, ADRs) not specific to docs/website's own code

agent.description: Ticket authored by sync_backlog.py from ROADMAP.md/CHANGELOG.md
